proposals.reason: FDA finalized PCCP guidance, extending pre-approved change control to all pathways (510(k), De Novo, PMA) for AI/ML medical devices.

card.x: Predetermined Change Control Plans now applicable to 510(k), De Novo, and PMA pathways for AI/ML devices. Enables pre-specified modifications without separate submissions.

proposals.reason: New implementing regulation establishes uniform requirements for notified body designation and surveillance under MDR/IVDR.

card.x: Updated Annex VII procedures for notified body designation and surveillance. Stricter technical and operational criteria for conformity assessment under MDR/IVDR.

proposals.reason: MDCG 2026-5 clarifies UDI-DI assignment responsibilities between manufacturers and distributors for EUDAMED registration.

card.x: Operational guidance on UDI-DI assignment responsibilities across the supply chain and EUDAMED registration obligations.

proposals.reason: ISO/TS 24971-2 published, providing risk management guidance specifically for Machine Learning-based medical devices.

card.x: Technical Specification complementing ISO 14971 with detailed risk identification, estimation, and control guidance for ML medical devices.

proposals.reason: MDR amendments establishing limited exemptions for certain legacy implantable devices under Articles 52.4 and 61.6.

card.x: Articles 52.4 and 61.6 establish conditional regulatory relief for specific categories of legacy implantable devices.

proposals.reason: Commission Decision 2026/1231 expands and updates harmonised standards catalogue for MDR compliance.

card.x: Expanded catalogue of harmonised standards covering safety, performance, biocompatibility, and device-specific requirements under MDR.

proposals.reason: MDCG 2021-24 Rev.1 clarifies software classification under Rule 11 with new examples and borderline scenarios.

card.x: Revised classification guide with enhanced Rule 11 clarifications for software and new borderline case examples.

proposals.reason: MDCG 2021-5 Annex mandates transition from EC REP to EU REP symbol with coexistence period for stock depletion.

card.t: MDCG 2021-5 Annex — EC REP to EU REP Transition
card.x: Authorized representative symbol transition from EC REP to EU REP with transitional stock depletion period.
